results.text: Resume classifier with embeddings, up from 71.8% with TF-IDF
Fake-news classifier. The investigation says why that overstates it
Churn ROC-AUC, with 83% recall on churners
Repos pinned, each with its caveat written down

projects.name: Sahi Daam Fair-Price Detector
projects.blurb: Estimates fair prices for Pakistani property listings and flags ones priced far above similar listings.
notes: Scraped from zameen.com with requests + BeautifulSoup, starting with DHA Islamabad rentals.
No headline metric yet. I will publish one when I can defend it.
projects.caveat: Fair prices for Pakistani property listings, from zameen.com. No headline metric until I can defend one.

projects.name: Resume Category Classifier
projects.blurb: Sorts resumes into 24 job categories and answers UNSURE when confidence is low.
notes: 74.4% with sentence embeddings, up from 71.8% with TF-IDF.
Reading the model weights showed which words it leans on, so I trust it where it says UNSURE, not blindly.
projects.caveat: Says UNSURE when it isn't confident. Shipped with FastAPI + Docker.

projects.name: Fake News Style Detector
projects.blurb: TF-IDF + Logistic Regression for fake vs real news, plus an investigation of what it learned.
notes: It learns the source's writing style, not truth. A "Reuters" shortcut sits in the top weights, so 98% overstates what it knows.
projects.caveat: It learned the source's style, not truth: a "Reuters" shortcut sits in the top weights.

projects.name: Churn Prediction Pipeline
projects.blurb: Predicts which customers will churn, from raw data to a live app.
notes: ColumnTransformer + Pipeline, deployed as an interactive Streamlit app.
projects.caveat: ColumnTransformer + Pipeline, deployed as a Streamlit app.
